raw.details:
NEXT STATION 2026 is a problem-solving hackathon focused on creativity, technology, innovation, and practical thinking.

Participants will get the opportunity to work on real-world challenges and develop innovative, technology-driven solutions that address meaningful problems.

The hackathon will feature 3 challenge tracks, with the complete problem statements and track details being revealed at a later stage.

Whether you are a developer, designer, researcher, or problem solver, NEXT STATION 2026 is an opportunity to transform ideas into practical solutions.

Participation:

  • Team Size: 1–3 members per team
  • Open to participants from across India
  • Participants may register individually or as a team
  • Each participant can be part of only one team
  • Teams will work on one of the challenge tracks revealed by the organizers

Guidelines & Rules:

  • Participants must provide accurate information during registration.
  • All submitted work must be original and created by the participating team.
  • Plagiarism, copied projects, or unauthorized use of another participant's work will result in disqualification.
  • Teams must follow the requirements and constraints specified for their respective challenge track.
  • Each team is responsible for submitting its work within the deadlines communicated by the organizers.
  • Participants may use publicly available tools, frameworks, libraries, datasets, and APIs unless restricted by the challenge guidelines.
  • The use of AI-assisted development tools is permitted unless otherwise specified in the challenge rules. Participants should be able to explain and demonstrate their submitted work.
  • Teams must ensure that their submission is functional, accessible, and available for evaluation when required.
  • Any attempt to manipulate the evaluation process, leaderboard, submissions, or event systems may lead to disqualification.
  • The organizers reserve the right to verify submissions and request clarification or demonstrations from participating teams.
  • The organizers' decision regarding eligibility, rule violations, and qualification will be final.
  • Detailed challenge requirements, evaluation criteria, timelines, and subsequent-stage instructions will be communicated through the official event channels.

Challenge Tracks:

  • There will be 3 distinct challenge tracks.
  • The tracks and their respective problem statements will be revealed later.
  • Further information regarding the hackathon process, evaluation, prizes, timelines, and track-specific requirements will be announced through official event updates.
